title.zh: Traders will soon be able to bet on whether Coinbase, Robinhood and Marathon will hit their targets
title.en: Traders will soon be able to bet on whether Coinbase, Robinhood and Marathon will hit their targets

current_state.zh: The SEC approved the listing of binary options tied to key performance indicators of 23 U.S.-listed companies, including Coinbase trading volume, Robinhood customer and revenue metrics, and MARA bitcoin production, creating a new way to trade crypto-linked company performance.
